    #hero .hero-overlay { display: none !important; }
    #hero .hero-inner { position: relative !important; z-index: 2 !important; }
    #hero h1 {
      color: #1B4283 !important;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.82rem + 1.45vw, 2.625rem) !important;
      font-weight: 700 !important;
      line-height: 1.35 !important;
    }
    #hero .hero-cta-row .btn-outline,
    #hero .hero-cta-btn--outline {
      color: #ffffff !important;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) !important;
    }
    #site-header.site-header,
    header#site-header {

      min-height: 64px !important;
      gap: 1rem !important;
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      #site-header .site-header__bar { min-height: 72px !important; }
    }
    #site-header nav[aria-label="منوی اصلی"] { display: none !important; }
    @media (min-width: 1280px) {
      #site-header nav[aria-label="منوی اصلی"] {
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        gap: 1.5rem !important;
        flex: 1 1 auto !important;
        justify-content: center !important;

      }

    #site-header .nav-dropdown button svg,
    #site-header .site-header__phone svg {

      }

    #site-header #sidebar-open { display: inline-flex !important; }
    @media (min-width: 1280px) {
      #site-header #sidebar-open { display: none !important; }
    }
    .delsa-footer-wrap,
    footer#contact.site-footer,
    footer#contact {
      background: #122f5c !important;
      background-color: #122f5c !important;
      color: #fff !important;
      width: 100vw !important;
      max-width: 100vw !important;
      margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
      margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
      padding: 2.5rem 0 3rem !important;
      box-sizing: border-box !important;
    }
    footer#contact .site-footer__grid {
      display: grid !important;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
      gap: 2rem !important;
      max-width: 1280px !important;
      margin: 0 auto 2rem !important;
      padding: 0 1.25rem !important;
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      footer#contact .site-footer__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr !important; }
    }
    footer#contact h4 { color: rgba(76,201,192,.65) !important; font-size: 11px !important; margin: 0 0 .75rem !important; }
    footer#contact p, footer#contact li { color: rgba(255,255,255,.55) !important; margin: 0 0 .5rem !important; }
    footer#contact a { color: rgba(255,255,255,.65) !important; text-decoration: none !important; }
    footer#contact a:hover { color: #4CC9C0 !important; }
    footer#contact .footer-brand > p:first-of-type { color: #fff !important; font-weight: 600 !important; }
    footer#contact .site-footer__contact-title { color: rgba(255,255,255,.9) !important; font-weight: 600 !important; }
    footer#contact .site-footer__phone-main { color: rgba(255,255,255,.75) !important; display: block !important; }
    footer#contact ul { list-style: none !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
    footer#contact .site-footer__bottom { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08) !important; padding-top: 1.25rem !important; max-width: 1280px !important; margin: 0 auto !important; padding-left: 1.25rem !important; padding-right: 1.25rem !important; }
    footer#contact .site-footer__bottom p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.35) !important; font-size: 12px !important; }
  </style>

<style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Vazirmatn', Tahoma, sans-serif;
      background: #FAF7F2;
      color: #1B4283;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      --header-h: 64px;
      /* Design tokens */
      --font: 'Vazirmatn', Tahoma, sans-serif;
      --radius-sm: 10px;
      --radius-md: 16px;
      --radius-lg: 20px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --radius-full: 999px;
      --text-xs: 0.8125rem;
      --text-sm: 0.875rem;
      --text-base: 1rem;
      --text-lg: 1.125rem;
      --text-xl: 1.375rem;
      --text-2xl: 1.75rem;
      --text-3xl: 2.125rem;
      --text-4xl: 2.625rem;
      --text-fluid-xs: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.79rem + 0.12vw, 0.875rem);
      --text-fluid-sm: clamp(0.875rem, 0.84rem + 0.18vw, 0.9375rem);
      --text-fluid-base: clamp(1rem, 0.96rem + 0.2vw, 1.0625rem);
      --text-fluid-lg: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.01rem + 0.28vw, 1.125rem);
      --text-fluid-xl: clamp(1.25rem, 1.15rem + 0.5vw, 1.375rem);
      --text-fluid-2xl: clamp(1.5rem, 1.38rem + 0.62vw, 1.75rem);
      --text-fluid-3xl: clamp(1.875rem, 1.65rem + 1.1vw, 2.25rem);
      --text-fluid-4xl: clamp(2rem, 1.82rem + 1.45vw, 2.625rem);
      --ink: #1B4283;
      --ink-dark: #122f5c;
      --teal: #4CC9C0;
      --gold: #F3E2B0;
      --sand: #FAF7F2;
      --sand-alt: #f8fbfc;
    }
    main, main * {
      font-family: var(--font);
    }
    .section-head h2,
    .section-title {
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-3xl);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.35;
      margin: 0;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .section-head p,
    .section-desc {
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-sm);
      line-height: 1.8;
      color: rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.62);
      margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
      font-weight: 400;
    }
    .bg-sand-50 { background: var(--sand-alt) !important; }
    .section--cream { background: var(--sand) !important; }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      body { --header-h: 72px; }
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #eef8f7; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #4CC9C0; border-radius: 3px; }

    .site-header {
      background: #ffffff;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.08);
      transition: box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }
    .site-header.scrolled {
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.08);
    }

    .nav-dropdown-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 12px);
      right: 0;
      min-width: 240px;
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.12);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(8px);
      transition: opacity 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), visibility 0.4s;
      z-index: 60;
    }
    .nav-dropdown:hover .nav-dropdown-menu,
    .nav-dropdown:focus-within .nav-dropdown-menu {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    .nav-dropdown-menu a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 20px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #1B4283;
      transition: background 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), padding-right 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.06);
    }
    .nav-dropdown-menu a:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .nav-dropdown-menu a:hover {
      background: #eef8f7;
      color: #3ab5ad;
      padding-right: 24px;
    }

    .sidebar-backdrop {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(18, 47, 92, 0.55);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), visibility 0.45s;
      z-index: 90;
    }
    .sidebar-backdrop.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
    .sidebar-panel {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      width: min(320px, 88vw);
      height: 100%;
      background: #1B4283;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
      z-index: 100;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .sidebar-panel.open { transform: translateX(0); }
    .sidebar-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 14px 0;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      transition: color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), padding-right 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }
    .sidebar-link:hover { color: #4CC9C0; padding-right: 6px; }
    .sidebar-sublink {
      display: block;
      padding: 10px 0 10px 16px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      transition: color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }
    .sidebar-sublink:hover { color: #4CC9C0; }

    .nav-dropdown { position: relative; }

    .nav-link {
      position: relative;
      transition: color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }
    .nav-link:hover { color: #3ab5ad; }
    .nav-link::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -2px;
      right: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: #4CC9C0;
      transition: width 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }
    .nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; }

    /* Hero — بکگراند متمایز + عکس + roadmap */
    #hero.hero-section {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      width: 100vw;
      max-width: 100vw;
      margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
      margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw);
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 70% at 12% -8%, rgba(76, 201, 192, 0.16), transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 55% at 98% 105%, rgba(243, 226, 176, 0.38), transparent 52%),
        linear-gradient(165deg, #e8f0f8 0%, #f3eee6 48%, #faf7f2 100%);
      isolation: isolate;
      box-shadow: 0 28px 56px -36px rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.22);
      padding-bottom: 3.5rem;
    }
    #hero.hero-section::before { display: none !important; }
    #hero .hero-overlay { display: none; }
    .hero-section__wave {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -1px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 4;
      line-height: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-section__wave svg {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: clamp(2.5rem, 2rem + 2vw, 3.5rem);
      fill: var(--sand);
    }
    #hero .hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem 2rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      #hero .hero-inner { padding: 3.5rem 1.25rem 2.5rem; }
    }
    .hero-blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }
    .hero-blob--1 {
      width: 420px;
      height: 420px;
      top: -120px;
      left: -80px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(76, 201, 192, 0.16) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }
    .hero-blob--2 {
      width: 360px;
      height: 360px;
      bottom: -80px;
      right: -60px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(243, 226, 176, 0.35) 0%, transparent 72%);
    }
    .hero-layout {
      display: grid;
      gap: 2rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .hero-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
        gap: 3rem;
      }
    }
    .hero-copy { text-align: right; max-width: 40rem; }
    .hero-eyebrow {
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-xs);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: #3ab5ad;
      margin: 0 0 1rem;
    }
    #hero h1 {
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-4xl);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.35;
      margin: 0 0 1rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .hero-h1-accent { color: #24508f; font-weight: 700; }
    .hero-lead {
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-lg);
      line-height: 1.85;
      color: rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.72);
      margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 400;
    }
    .hero-seo {
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-xs);
      color: rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.48);
      margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .hero-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(6.5rem, 1fr));
      gap: clamp(.4rem, 2vw, .625rem);
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 2rem 0 0;
    }
    .hero-stats li {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.08);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 0.875rem 0.75rem;
      text-align: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.04);
    }
    .hero-stats strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-base);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
      margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    }
    .hero-stats span {
      display: block;
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-xs);
      color: rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.55);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }
    .hero-hook {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-xs);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(243, 226, 176, 0.55) 0%, rgba(76, 201, 192, 0.18) 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 192, 0.28);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      padding: 0.4rem 0.875rem;
      margin: 0 0 1rem;
    }
    .hero-visual-stack {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .hero-photo {
      position: relative;
      margin: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
      box-shadow: 0 22px 52px rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.16);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    }
    .hero-photo img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center 32%;
      display: block;
    }
    .hero-photo__shine {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(125deg, rgba(250, 247, 242, 0.12) 0%, transparent 42%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.18) 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-photo__badge {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0.875rem;
      right: 0.875rem;
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-xs);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #fff;
      background: rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.72);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
    }
    .hero-roadmap {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(155deg, #1B4283 0%, #234a8a 38%, #1a6a7a 100%);
      padding: 1.75rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 28px 64px rgba(27, 66, 131, 0.28);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    }
    .hero-roadmap__glow {
      position: absolute;
      top: -40%;
      left: -20%;
      width: 70%;
      height: 80%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(76, 201, 192, 0.35) 0%, transparent 68%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-roadmap__brand {
      position: absolute;
      top: 1rem;
      left: 1rem;
      width: 3rem;
      height: 3rem;
      opacity: 0.15;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-roadmap__glow--2 {
      top: auto;
      bottom: -30%;
      left: auto;
      right: -15%;
      width: 55%;
      height: 65%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(243, 226, 176, 0.22) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }
    .hero-roadmap__label {
      position: relative;
      font-size: var(--text-fluid-xs);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(76, 201, 192, 0.95);

<!-- Scripts — بدون </body> و بدون script خارجی (سازگار با Elementor) -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      function initDelsaPage() {
        var header = document.getElementById('site-header') || document.getElementById('delsa-site-header');
        if (header) {
          var onScroll = function () { header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 20); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();
        }

        var sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar') || document.getElementById('delsa-sidebar');
        var sidebarBackdrop = document.getElementById('sidebar-backdrop') || document.getElementById('delsa-sidebar-backdrop');
        var sidebarOpenBtn = document.getElementById('sidebar-open') || document.getElementById('delsa-sidebar-open');
        var sidebarCloseBtn = document.getElementById('sidebar-close') || document.getElementById('delsa-sidebar-close');
        var mobileCtaBar = document.getElementById('mobile-cta-bar');
        var heroSection = document.getElementById('hero');
        var whatsappFloat = document.getElementById('whatsapp-float');
        var appointmentModal = document.getElementById('appointment-modal');

        /* Cinematic, video-like engagement: entrance sequence, scroll reveals,
           and gentle parallax while the hero is visible. */
        if (heroSection) {
          requestAnimationFrame(function () { heroSection.classList.add('is-cinematic-ready'); });

          var cinematicItems = document.querySelectorAll(
            '#services .service-card, #concerns .concern-item, #why-delsa .why-card, #how-it-works .step-card, #faq .faq-item'
          );
          cinematicItems.forEach(function (item, index) {
            item.classList.add('delsa-scroll-reveal');
            item.style.transitionDelay = Math.min((index % 5) * 70, 280) + 'ms';
          });
          if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
            var revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries, observer) {
              entries.forEach(function (entry) {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                  entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
                  observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
              });
            }, { threshold: .12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px' });
            cinematicItems.forEach(function (item) { revealObserver.observe(item); });
          } else {
            cinematicItems.forEach(function (item) { item.classList.add('is-visible'); });
          }

          var parallaxTicking = false;
          window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
            if (parallaxTicking) return;
            parallaxTicking = true;
            requestAnimationFrame(function () {
              var bounds = heroSection.getBoundingClientRect();
              var shift = Math.max(-18, Math.min(18, -bounds.top * .08));
              heroSection.style.setProperty('--hero-parallax-y', shift + 'px');
              parallaxTicking = false;
            });
          }, { passive: true });
        }

        function hideFloatingUi() {
          if (mobileCtaBar) mobileCtaBar.classList.add('hidden-by-overlay');
          if (whatsappFloat) whatsappFloat.classList.add('hidden-by-overlay');
        }

        function showFloatingUi() {
          if (sidebar && sidebar.classList.contains('open')) return;
          if (appointmentModal && appointmentModal.classList.contains('active')) return;
          if (mobileCtaBar) mobileCtaBar.classList.remove('hidden-by-overlay');
          if (whatsappFloat) whatsappFloat.classList.remove('hidden-by-overlay');
        }

        if (appointmentModal) {
          var openAppointmentBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.js-open-appointment');

          function closeAppointmentModal() {
            appointmentModal.classList.remove('active');
            appointmentModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            showFloatingUi();
          }

          function openAppointmentModal() {
            if (sidebar && sidebar.classList.contains('open')) {
              sidebar.classList.remove('open');
              sidebarBackdrop.classList.remove('open');
              sidebar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
              sidebarBackdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            }
            appointmentModal.classList.add('active');
            appointmentModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            hideFloatingUi();
            var panel = appointmentModal.querySelector('.modal-panel');
            if (panel) panel.focus();
          }

          openAppointmentBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
              e.preventDefault();
              openAppointmentModal();
            });
          });

          appointmentModal.querySelectorAll('[data-close-modal]').forEach(function (el) {
            el.addEventListener('click', closeAppointmentModal);
          });

          document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && appointmentModal.classList.contains('active')) {
              closeAppointmentModal();
            }
          });
        }

        if (sidebar && sidebarBackdrop && sidebarOpenBtn && sidebarCloseBtn) {
    function updateMobileCtaOverlay() {
      if (!mobileCtaBar) return;
          var hidden = sidebar.classList.contains('open') ||
            (appointmentModal && appointmentModal.classList.contains('active'));
      mobileCtaBar.classList.toggle('hidden-by-overlay', hidden);
      if (whatsappFloat) whatsappFloat.classList.toggle('hidden-by-overlay', hidden);
    }

    function openSidebar() {
          if (appointmentModal && appointmentModal.classList.contains('active')) {
            appointmentModal.classList.remove('active');
            appointmentModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          }
      sidebar.classList.add('open');
      sidebarBackdrop.classList.add('open');
      sidebar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      sidebarBackdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      updateMobileCtaOverlay();
    }

    function closeSidebar() {
      sidebar.classList.remove('open');
      sidebarBackdrop.classList.remove('open');
      sidebar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      sidebarBackdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      updateMobileCtaOverlay();
    }

    sidebarOpenBtn.addEventListener('click', openSidebar);
    sidebarCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
    sidebarBackdrop.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
        sidebar.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (link) {
          link.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && sidebar.classList.contains('open')) closeSidebar();
    });
        }

    if (mobileCtaBar && heroSection && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1023px)').matches) {
          var heroObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
            mobileCtaBar.classList.toggle('visible', !entries[0].isIntersecting);
      }, { threshold: 0 });
      heroObserver.observe(heroSection);
    } else if (mobileCtaBar) {
      document.body.classList.remove('has-mobile-cta');
    }
      }

      if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initDelsaPage);
      } else {
        initDelsaPage();
      }
    })();
  </script>
